prompt: Which workspace has a channel with a member named Robert who posted that our launch is being pushed back for a compliance review?
binding_note: The workspace must be reached by finding one of its channels whose member (a user first-named Robert) is also the author of a message announcing a launch delay tied to compliance review; membership binds channel+user, authorship binds that same user+message. Robert Chen (member of core-infra in the Test Workspace) and Robert Kim (member of general in Nebula Labs) both satisfy this chain, so two distinct workspaces qualify and the request does not disambiguate between them.

roles.reason: second candidate workspace satisfying the route

obligations.name: identify_delay_workspace
obligations.description: Select the workspace(s) reachable by a channel whose member named Robert authored a message announcing the launch delay tied to compliance review; report the matching workspace(s).
obligations.scope: workspaces visible to the acting user through their channel memberships

task_spec.text: Identify which workspace has a channel with a member named Robert who posted that the launch is being pushed back for a compliance review, and report which workspace it is.

access_plan: The acting user (agent1) is a member of channels in both T01WORKSPACE (e.g., core-infra) and T02NEBULA (general), so users.conversations/conversations.list can surface both workspaces' channels. conversations.members identifies the Robert-named member in each channel (cross-checked with users.info for real_name/display_name), and conversations.history or search.messages over each candidate's channels surfaces the message announcing the compliance-driven launch delay authored by that same member, yielding two qualifying workspaces.
